Standort: Berlin

Veröffentlichungsdatum: 01.03.2026

Arbeitszeit: Full time

Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!
OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK
We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCE

Collaborate in a dynamic, diverse, and innovation-driven environment, where your experience and leadership will be valued.

- 
Design, set up, maintain, and continually enhance our AWS cloud resources using infrastructure-as-code and support the roll-out of new payment products and services from infrastructure perspective.

- 
Take ownership of deployments during releases and ensuring the sound functioning of CI/CD pipelines.

- 
Further develop our data pipeline with integrations to various systems.

- 
Leverage your Datadog expertise to enhance and maintain platform reliability and monitoring.

- 
Drive IT Operations during the roll-out of existing products to new markets and use-cases.

- 
Collaborate with Mercedes-Benz Group IT specialists and external providers to co-create innovative solutions.

- 
Play a key role in ensuring the operational excellence of our global payment platform.

- 
Ensure compliance of all operational products with Mercedes policies and relevant external laws and regulations.

Qualifikationen WHAT WE EXPECT

A burning passion for IT, along with an open-minded and highly motivated attitude.

- 
Successful completion of relevant studies in Computer Science or equivalent work experience.

- 
Strong solution-oriented, problem-solving and analytical skills.

- 
Proficiency in cloud service architecture best practices and experience in writing infrastructure-as-code.

- 
Skilled at Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm and experience with software programming (e.g. Java), Git SCM, and proficiency in the Atlassian Toolchain.

- 
Datadog hands-on experience, and deep understanding of features and capabilities.

- 
Experience with platform reliability best practices, set up of monitors, automated alerts and on-call service.

- 
Knowledge of IT security best practice and common standards.

- Fluent business English skills.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Modern and dynamic work environment
- Flexible and mobile working
- Attractive fitness offer
- Numerous employee discounts
- Excellent infrastructure

This is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:). For questions, please don’t hesitate to contact the HR Team of Mercedes
pay GmbH: career_mercedespay@mercedes-benz.com

jobs.occupation: Quality Manager (all genders) in Space Hardware Production (Qualitätsmanager/in)
jobs.description:
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES THE WHY At Blackwave, we develop and manufacture Composite Overwrapped Pressure Vessels and carbon fiber structures for the space industry — hardware where failure is not an option. As we scale from one site in Germany to two with our new facility in Texas, quality can't be an afterthought or a paper exercise. We're looking for a Quality Manager who builds a pragmatic, ISO 9001-compliant Quality Management System from the ground up for our Texas site, keeps our German QMS sharp, and creates a quality culture that engineers, operators, and management actually live — not one that gathers dust in a document folder. THE WHAT
• Own ISO 9001 at both sites: Maintain certification in Germany and establish it in Texas, preparing all audits — internal, certification, and customer — together with the teams so they're passed without major findings. Blackwave Code: High Performance
• Build processes people actually use: Define and implement essential quality processes that are pragmatic and scalable enough for development, manufacturing, and management to apply confidently in daily work. Blackwave Code: Togetherness
• Make performance visible: Give leadership clear, up-to-date visibility into company performance through meaningful KPIs and management reviews that drive decisions rather than just report numbers. Blackwave Code: Candor
• Own risk end-to-end: Establish and actively maintain a company-wide risk management system covering organizational, process, and product risks — with clear ownership and follow-up on mitigations. Blackwave Code: Accountability
• Digitize quality: Establish a digital QMS platform as the mandatory system of record, with quality documentation and workflows fully migrated and adopted across the organization. Blackwave Code: Playfulness

YOUR PROFILE
• 3–5+ years of experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment — you've stood on a shop floor, not just in an office
• Degree in a technical field (e.g. aerospace or mechanical engineering) plus relevant further training in quality management
• Hands-on ISO 9001 experience: you've managed audit cycles and can walk us through a process you set up yourself, end to end
• Pragmatic quality mindset: you build processes for usage, not just for compliance — standards are an enabler, not bureaucracy
• Builder mentality: you create structures from scratch rather than maintaining what's already there, and you see a bit of chaos as an opportunity
• Strong ownership and communication at all levels — from C-level to operator
• Fluent English is a must; German is a plus

WHAT WE OFFER
• Freedom to Create: Extensive decision-making freedom and short decision paths – we trust your expertise to lead your team.
• Fresh Fuel Every Day: Shared lunch breaks with freshly prepared, varied meals to keep the team energized.
• Coffee Culture @ Blackwave: Enjoy premium coffee from our portafilter machine or join one of our barista courses.
• Choose Your Perk: Select from a Deutschland-Ticket, EGYM Wellpass, or a Give Card.
• Gear up for Take-off: Receive premium Blackwave team apparel during your on boarding.
• Grow in Aerospace: Expand your professional horizons in a high-growth company at the forefront of space technology.
• Rooftop Relaxation: End your day on our spacious rooftop terrace with a panoramic view of the Alps.

About us Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

jobs.description:
LOGISTICS REPRESENTATIVE (F/M/D)

At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop regulated technology that helps unlock better evidence and improve patient outcomes worldwide. Our software platforms support clinical trials, diagnostics, and medical decision?making in highly controlled regulatory environments.

We are looking for you as Logistics Representative (f/m/d) to support our international administration team in full time (40h/week) at our Estenfeld (near Würzburg) site.

Be a part of driving clinical trials faster with your daily performance. You will be responsible for ensuring that our customers (pharma companies) can be confident that our test devices for our eCoa (digital patient diary), Respiratory (lung function devices) and Cardiac (blood pressure devices) business lines are sent out in time to arrive at medical sites (test centres and hospitals) worldwide. Make a difference by performing all operational tasks within the Warehouse, Receiving and Shipping area.

Even if you don't have any experience in the world of clinical trials, we are happy to show you!

WHAT WE OFFER

*
Hybrid work environment (3 to 4 days in office, 1 to 2 days remote)

*
Flexible working hours and working time accounts to support the work-life balance

*
Support your professional development through internal and external training and certification programs

*
Modern office building with an on-site canteen offering freshly cooked local dishes (with vegetarian option)

*
Competitive Salary

*
Company pension scheme

*
The office in Estenfeld is well connected to the transport network. For public transport users, Clario offers the Deutschlandticket

*
Free onsite parking

*
We have both social and wellness committees that organize parties, events and activities

*
One-year contract with the goal of extension for long-term employment

WHAT YOU´LL BE DOING

*
Perform data entry and process related paperwork according to established guidelines

*
Support coordination scheduling with departments within Manufacturing and Supply Chain and other Clario departments as needed 

*
Support coordination of shipments and production orders on a daily basis for all lines of business

*
Monitor and report shipment and order status tracking information and escalate in case of emergency

*
Check compliance with the promised shipping/receiving dates and all needed documents

*
Business related communication with internal departments and external forwarders

*
Support organizing and processing of global in- / outbound shipments

*
Maintain performance indicators

*
Supports reasonable operation tasks within Logistics

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

*
Bachelor's degree in business administration, engineering, or related fields (preferred) or equivalent experience in supply chain, engineering, or operations management

*
Apprenticeship/professional work training program in logistics, forwarding, industrial environments or related fields

*
Preferred minimum 6 months logistics, supply chain or industrial administrational environment experience

*
Fluent proficiency in English and an advanced level in German

*
Experience in a fast-paced environment; with an ability to work independently, and cross-functionally as needed

*
Familiarity with computer databases, spreadsheets, and Microsoft Office Suite

*
ERP experience is preferred

*
Excellent organizational and communication skills

*
Ability to work as a part of a team as well as an individual contributor

*
Good degree of reliability, flexibility and independence 

*
Strong presence with the ability to interact with senior leadership and external and internal clients

*
Professional approach with high attention to details and deadlines

At Clario, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

Sebastian Braun

jobs.occupation: Offshore LTP Project Manager (f/m/d) – Gas Turbine Projects (Ingenieur/in - Energietechnik)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Offshore LTP Project Manager in SE GS AP PM C3, you play a key role in delivering Gas Turbine Long-Term Program projects and in building long-term customer success in Korea, Japan, and Australia.

You drive project execution from a technical, commercial, and operational perspective and work closely with your onshore Project Management partners to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the expected quality standards. In doing so, you act as a key interface between the customer and internal stakeholders and help turn project challenges into practical solutions.

In your daily work, you collaborate across functions including Engineering, Field Service, Procurement, Finance, Sales, and Onshore Project Management. Your ability to stay structured, build trust, and keep execution on track contributes directly to customer satisfaction and business success.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Project Ownership:Take full responsibility for the execution of assigned Gas Turbine LTP projects across the Asia Pacific region.
* Customer Success:Build strong customer relationships through reliable execution, transparent communication, and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
* Execution Excellence:Ensure delivery in line with project scope, schedule, cost, quality, and contractual requirements.
* Commercial Performance:Actively manage project cost, invoicing, cash flow, risks and opportunities, claims, and change order potential in close cooperation with Commercial Project Manager.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration:Work closely with Onshore Project Management, Engineering, Field Service, Procurement, Finance, and Sales to achieve project and business targets.
* Problem Solving:Identify risks and issues early, drive mitigation actions, and support timely resolution of technical, operational, and commercial topics.
* Continuous Improvement:Apply project management standards and tools with discipline and contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and ways of working.

What You Bring

* BS in Engineering or related field of study
* Significant professional experience in project management, ideally in Gas Turbine service business and/or Long-Term Program execution
* Strong technical and commercial understanding of project execution in the power generation industry
* Experience managing customer interfaces and coordinating cross-functional teams in an international business environment
* Strong communication skills and the ability to manage technical, operational, commercial, and customer-related topics in a structured and professional manner
* Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to manage priorities in a dynamic environment
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required
* Business proficiency in both German and English
* Project Management certification (e.g. IPMA, PMI or comparable) is considered an advantage

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme 
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder 
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity 
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programs and learning materials are available for this purpose 
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical   

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

What you’ll do 

As JetBrains expands its cloud and SaaS offerings, maintaining customer trust and robust security compliance is critical. We are investing in the security posture and compliance program for JetBrains Cloud Platform (JCP), a new JetBrains offering, moving beyond checklist-driven security to build practical, real-world controls.

In this role, you will take ownership of our compliance program from design to execution, focusing on SOC 2 and ISO standards. You’ll sit at the intersection of product security, platform engineering, legal, and customer-facing teams. Rather than imposing rigid bureaucracy, you’ll help design workflows that protect user data while keeping development teams fast and autonomous. You’ll also serve as a key technical voice on compliance matters, speaking directly with customers to explain our security architecture and build trust.

Day to day, you will:

- Design, implement, and mature the compliance program for JCP, focusing initially on SOC 2 (Type 1 and Type 2) and ISO standards (such as ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, and 42001).
- Translate complex framework requirements into clear, practical controls that fit how JetBrains builds products.
- Partner with product security, platform engineering, legal, and people teams to embed security and compliance requirements into day-to-day work (policies, procedures, onboarding, training, SDLC, vendor management, etc.).
- Coordinate evidence collection, control testing, and remediation for internal reviews and external audits.
- Maintain and improve core compliance documentation, including policies, standards, control catalogs, risk registers, and playbooks.
- Respond to customer security questionnaires, participate in due diligence calls, and collaborate with account teams to handle non-standard compliance requests.
- Monitor changes in relevant standards and regulations and help keep our program aligned with them.

What you’ll bring

- A practical mindset that values clear systems and real outcomes over rigid checklists.
- A clear, structured communication style that makes technical security concepts accessible to any audience.
- A detail-oriented approach with the curiosity to navigate both policy text and technical architecture.
- Calmness and confidence when guiding customers through security due diligence.

What you’ll need

- Established hands-on experience building and maturing compliance programs around SOC 2 and ISO security standards.
- Experience managing security compliance in SaaS or cloud environments (such as AWS, GCP, or Azure).
- Practical experience across core security and compliance domains, including access management, logging, secure development, vendor risk, and business continuity.
- A track record of collaborating effectively with technical teams (engineering, SRE, product security, etc.) and turning framework language into concrete, realistic requirements.
- Direct experience answering customer security questionnaires and leading customer-facing compliance discussions.
- Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.

It would be great if you also have:

- Experience with other frameworks and regulations relevant to SaaS, such as FedRAMP, ISMAP, or others.
- Experience working inside or closely with product security, cloud security, or risk management teams.
- Familiarity with security and compliance tooling (such as GRC platforms, ticketing systems, policy and evidence repositories, asset and identity management tools).
- Prior experience in a fast-growing or multi-product environment where processes and ownership boundaries are evolving.

What success looks like 

Success in this role means establishing a clear, reliable compliance foundation for JetBrains Cloud Platform that strengthens customer trust and respects engineering autonomy.
